text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. As I was heading to the 
Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan! We're gonna defeat 
Spe-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Umm... but, well... This battle is on a 
completely different grade, so to speak...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu~, I'm so glad you asked! There's 
an amazing tournament coming up at the 
shopping district! And its name is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"The Legend: Challenge Special Week! 
~Finish the Super-Sized Ramen Bowl~"!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
She's so cool! A true legend! This is 
definitely gonna be fun~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And guess what! When I asked at the ramen 
shop, they just happened to be looking for 
two more participants!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, come on, Grass-chan! Let's take on the 
challenge together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, Urara-chan... can you finish all of 
that? Your lunch usually seems smaller 
than mine...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine! I just won't eat 
breakfast before going!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I wonder about that. Just going off 
that alone, it's hard to say...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Right, they're a Legend after 
all... Then... it's a huge shame, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'll even give up my snack-time carrot 
ice cream!! All to beat Spe-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...
choice_data_list: Let's definitely take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! Races are definitely much 
more fun than eating a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mmm! That's so true!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ramen fills your belly, but races fill you 
with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I've decided to become a legend 
through racing!

Thanks in part to Grass Wonder's help, we 
managed to avert the weight-gain 
crisis...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely gonna become a 
legend! Legendary Urara...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, such magnificent fortitude. Best of 
luck to the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You did say you wanted to 'give it a shot' 
earlier, after all~. I'll be cheering you 
on with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Trainer, you're gonna enter?! Yay, 
yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all together! And then 
we'll become... legends!

Later on, the Legend's seriousness was 
overwhelming... I felt like I wouldn't 
want ramen again for quite a while.
